extra_quotes: Across the two suites’ train and rate-reference collections, the median slowdown ranges from 45.4× to 48.5×; the CPU2017 refrate median is 46.6×, and CPU2026 refrate is 45.6×.
We repeated both train and refrate profile collection three times for three CPU2026 workloads with large train/reference fidelity gaps: 729.abc, 735.gem5, and 777.zstd.

The method is therefore appropriate for proxy/full-workload, train/reference, or configuration/input comparisons, but not for comparing independently built binaries without additional symbolization or normalization.
This is a targeted single-threaded replication study, rather than a claim that every workload or multithreaded execution has the same determinism.
